title: Handley Page Halifax NA612
memorial_details: Square, black, granite tablet mounted at a low angle on a brick and cobble plinth. The dedication is in white, upper and lower-case letters. A coloured Bomber Command crest and the outline of a Halifax bomber are located at the top-left corner.
inscription: Heading: IN MEMORY OF THE CREW OF HALIFAX BOMBER NA612 KILLED IN ACTION/ NEAR BRAFFERTON WHILE RETURING TO RAF DISHFORTH FROM A MISSION/ OVER GERMANY AT 0112 HOURS ON 4TH MARCH 1943. Left column: P/O Kenneth William Griffey/ Sgt Sidney Forster/ WO John William Buttrey/ Fg Off George Henry Lloyd/ WO Lawrence Theodore Chevrier/ Sgt Leonard Boardman/ Flt Sgt John Edward Fielder/ EVERY MAN WAS A VOLUNTEER/ 55573 BOMBER COMMAND AIRCREW WERE KILLED DURING WORLD WAR II/ INCLUDING 9919 FROM CANADA/ THEY ARE REMEMBERED BY THE PEOPLE OF HELPERBY AND BRAFFERTON RH column: (Background surrounding the loss of NA612)/ STRIKE HARD STRIKE SURE
community_connection: The memorial is maintained by Brafferton Parish Council.
